Interviews.name: Name
Welcome_description: Hi. I am artificial intelligence CheckmeAI and my mission is to prepare you for a real technical interview for the position of junior, middle or senior. During the interview I will ask you the most frequently asked questions from real interviews. Just choose a topic, level and check whether your knowledge matches the desired position.
Preparation.restart_confirm_text: You have an interview in progress. If you start a new one, the current interview will be lost.
Preparation.you_should_know: What you should you know before
Preparation.info_item.count_questions: The interview consists of {{ value }} of the most frequently asked questions on real interviews
Preparation.info_item.questions_not_prep: The interview questions are not prepared in advance, they are generated by me in real time
Preparation.info_item.continue: The interview cannot be continued if you log out
Preparation.info_item.timer: Each question has {{ value }} minutes to answer, after the time expires you will move on to the next question automatically
Preparation.info_item.previous_question: Return to the previous question is not possible
Preparation.info_item.recommendations: After the interview, you will be able to get a list of recommendations from {{ projectName }}, depending on the result.
Preparation.info_item.questions_are_prep: In the free mode, I prepared the questions in advance, but are also the most frequently asked questions at the interview.
Preparation.info_item.certificate: On successful completion of the interview, AI will give you a certificate to prove your knowledge which you can download.
Preparation.info_item.is_passed_intervie: The interview is considered passed if 75% or more of the answers are correct.
description_mode_1: The questions are simple and easy to understand. The interview will be conducted in a relaxed atmosphere.
description_mode_2: The questions are complex and require a deep understanding of the topic. The interview will be conducted in a tense atmosphere.
available_in_warmup_and_interview_mode: Available in Warm-up and Interview modes
choosing_level_description: Choose the level of the {{ topicName }} interview preparation.
choosing_mode_description: `Choose the mode of the {{ topicName }} interview preparation.
error_login_provider: Invalid credentials or login method. Try another login method or use the one you registered with.
not_available_free_move_message: Mode has already been used. Only one interview is available in "Free" mode.
not_available_paid_mode_message: Mode has already been used. Only one paid interview is available in the demo.
explanation_feature_description: After completing any of the interviews, you will be able to get a detailed explanation of the correct answer for each question.
practical_application_feature_descriptio: After completing any of the interviews, you will be able to immediately get an example of the practical application of each question.
certificate_feature_description: If you successfully answered {{ percentage }}% of the questions in Interview mode, you will receive a AI certificate from me that confirms your expertise in this topic and level.
public_result_feature_description: If you successfully pass the Interview mode, you can share a link with your result. Anyone who has this link will be able to view your result and verify your expertise. This could be HR at the first stages of hiring and a technical specialist of the company you want to get into.
recommendation_feature_description: After completing the interview, I will analyze your answers and make personal recommendations for you - where exactly you have gaps in knowledge and what exactly you need to study.
strict_interview_mode_additional_desc: Don't worry, if you really want to test your knowledge, these limitations shouldn't scare you.
error_continue_interview_desc: It looks like you started the interview from another device or browser. You can only continue the interview from the browser you started it with.
test_card_hint: Test card: 4242 4242 4242 4242, any future date, any CVC.
JobVacancySection.title: Get ready for
JobVacancySection.description: Paste the job title, company name and key requirements from any job posting. {{ projectName }} turns them into the questions you are most likely to hear at that interview, checks your answers and explains every mistake, so you know exactly what to brush up on before the real one.
JobVacancySection.example.requirement_1: 1+ year of manual and API testing
JobVacancySection.example.requirement_3: Clear test cases and bug reports
JobVacancySection.example.question: The payment API accepts a card that expired last month. What do you check first?
JobVacancySection.example.option_1: Expiry date validation on the server
JobVacancySection.example.option_2: Page load speed of the checkout
JobVacancySection.example.option_3: Color contrast of the Pay button
